- Added a "Start on APIDot" section for quick access to key APIDot entry points from ClawHub.

- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

apidot-kling-o3-api v1.0.0 – Initial release

- Provides documentation-only guidance for using APIDot's Kling O3 API workflows (Standard, Pro, 4K, text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-guided video, multi-shot, Native Audio).
- Includes model routing, async task handling, polling, webhook integration, and security rules for API key management.
- Routes user questions to official APIDot docs, model pages, examples, and reference notes.
- No executable code, API clients, or credential storage included—purely reference material.
- Use for planning or building Kling O3 workflows with APIDot, not for live API calls or commercial advice.
